tools.name: search_vaults
tools.description: Search and filter DeFi vaults by chain, protocol, asset, risk tier, TVL, and more. Returns a paginated list with risk scores and APR.

query.description: Search by vault name, symbol, asset, protocol, or curator

chain.description: Filter by chain name or slug (e.g. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Solana)

protocol.description: Filter by protocol ID: aave, morpho, spark, compound, yearn, beefy, uniswap, nest, maple, kamino. Aave V4 is protocol=aave plus protocolVersion=v4 (aave-v4 is accepted as an alias).

protocolVersion.description: Filter by protocol generation: v3, v4, v3-lido, v3-horizon, klend, kvault. Required to isolate Aave V4 (protocol=aave, protocolVersion=v4). Vaults list this as protocol_version.

asset.description: Filter by asset symbol (e.g. USDC, WETH)

riskTier.description: Filter by risk tier: Prime, Core, or Edge

depositable.description: Filter by current ability to accept new deposits. When true, vaults whose depositability is not yet indexed are still included; when false, only vaults whose maxDeposit on-chain is zero (caps reached, paused, or supply queue saturated) are returned.

sortBy.description: Sort field: tvl_usd, apr_net, name, last_synced_at

tools.name: get_vault
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific DeFi vault including risk breakdown, recent events, and historical snapshots. Lookup by ID or by network + address.

network.description: Network slug from the chain registry (e.g. ethereum, base, arbitrum, solana). /v1/chains lists slugs for chains with active vaults.

address.description: Vault address in the chain's namespace: 0x-hex on EVM chains, base58 (case-sensitive) on Solana

tools.name: get_vault_risk_breakdown
tools.description: Get a detailed breakdown of a vault's risk vectors: Asset Composition, Platform and Strategy, Control and Governance, and History scores with sub-metrics.

network.description: Network slug from the chain registry (e.g. ethereum, base, arbitrum, solana). /v1/chains lists slugs for chains with active vaults.

address.description: Vault address in the chain's namespace: 0x-hex on EVM chains, base58 (case-sensitive) on Solana

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List lending markets: the market a depositor actually picks (Aave/Spark pool, Aave V4 spoke, Compound Comet, Morpho Blue pair, or Kamino K-Lend market). Aave V4 spokes that share a liquidity hub are grouped under a composed parent (aave-v4-1-hub-global-dollar). The API still keys each market on the spoke. NOTE: this is not `get_market_overview`, which returns platform-wide totals across all vaults.

protocol.description: Filter by protocol id: aave, spark, compound, morpho, kamino. Aave V4 is protocol=aave plus version=v4 (aave-v4 is accepted as an alias).

version.description: Filter by protocol version: v3, v4, or klend. Use version=v4 with protocol=aave.

chain.description: Filter by chain: integer chain id (e.g. 1, 8453) or slug (e.g. ethereum, solana)

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Get one lending market with every reserve it contains: supplied, supply APR, borrowed, borrow APR, utilization and risk tier per reserve. Spoke ids look like aave-v4-10-etherfi-cash. Aave V4 hub parents (aave-v4-1-hub-global-dollar) are composed from the spokes that share that hub; /v1/markets does not serve those ids.

marketId.description: Market id from list_markets. Spoke example: aave-v4-10-etherfi-cash. Hub example: aave-v4-1-hub-global-dollar.

tools.name: get_market_events
tools.description: Published risk events for ONE lending market: incidents, bad debt, liquidation cascades (e.g. mass liquidations on a Morpho Blue market). Market ids look like morpho-v1-1-pt-reusd-10dec2026-usdc-91-5. Aave V4 hub ids (aave-v4-1-hub-global-dollar) union the spoke feeds. Not platform stats (get_market_overview) and not the market data itself (get_market).

marketId.description: Market id from list_markets. Spoke or composed hub parent (aave-v4-1-hub-global-dollar).

tools.name: check_loop_venue
tools.description: Underwrite a collateral/debt loop on ONE lending market: score, tier, utilization, borrow APR, deposit status, and recent incidents for both reserves. Does not compute health factor and does not prepare txs. Call this before a protocol MCP preview_action / prepare_action. If you do not have a market id, call list_markets first (Aave V4: protocol=aave, version=v4). Examples: aave-v4-1-main, aave-v4-10-etherfi-cash, aave-v4-1-hub-global-dollar.

marketId.description: Market id from list_markets. Spoke example: aave-v4-1-main. Hub example: aave-v4-1-hub-global-dollar.

collateral.description: Collateral asset symbol you will post (e.g. weETH, WETH, cbBTC).

debt.description: Debt asset symbol you will borrow (e.g. USDC, USDT, GHO).

tools.name: list_ondo_assets
tools.description: Search the paginated Ondo Global Markets catalog: tokenized securities, portfolios and exact issuer-reported deployments. Includes API-only and CSV-only entries, freshness and identity conflicts. This is not a list of verified risk scores.

tools.name: get_ondo_asset
tools.description: Get an exact Ondo token: issuer market observations, portfolio constituents, source freshness and chain/address assessment links. Prices are display-only; constituents have no inferred weights or inherited ratings.

symbol.description: Exact case-sensitive Ondo token symbol, for example SPYon; obtain it from list_ondo_assets.

tools.name: get_ondo_asset_stream
tools.description: Get latest retained Ondo display prices and minute OHLC. Preserve source/receipt ages, evaluatedAt, conflicts and collector gaps; fresh is a 120-second policy at evaluatedAt, not an execution guarantee. Missing values are not zero. This does not open an issuer subscription or supply history.

symbol.description: Exact case-sensitive Ondo token symbol, for example SPYon; obtain it from list_ondo_assets.

tools.name: get_ondo_asset_data
tools.description: Get Ondo OHLC, dividends, shares-multiplier history and per-chain token supply. Family availability and source clocks are explicit. Valid windows: 1min/1day, 5min/1day, 15min/1day, 1hour/1month, 4hour/1month, 12hour/3month, or 1day with 3month, 6month, 1year, all. Defaults to 1hour/1month. Underlying dividend yield is a decimal, not token distribution yield. Supply is in token units, not USD.

symbol.description: Exact case-sensitive Ondo token symbol, for example SPYon; obtain it from list_ondo_assets.

tools.name: get_native_asset_assessment
tools.description: Get the current effective score and signed reviewed base score for an exact Aptos, Sui, Noble, Stellar or XRP Ledger token. Preserve identifier case. A missing assessment is not a zero score. Evidence and signatures require the caller’s own entitled Philidor API key. verified is the API assertion, not independent verification against a reviewer trust root.

identifier.description: Complete native token identifier, preserving case

tools.name: get_native_asset_financials
tools.description: Get public issuer financials for an exact Aptos, Sui, Noble, Stellar or XRP Ledger token. Preserve identifier case. Each metric states its unit, fund/global/deployment scope, source and freshness; null means unavailable, not zero. Fund AUM and NAV do not establish token supply, redemption capacity or reserves. Requery by refreshBy; this tool does not return a risk score or private account data.

identifier.description: Complete native token identifier, preserving case

tools.name: compare_vaults
tools.description: Compare 2-3 DeFi vaults side-by-side on TVL, APR, risk score, risk tier, audited status, and more.

network.description: Network slug from the chain registry (e.g. ethereum, base, arbitrum, solana). /v1/chains lists slugs for chains with active vaults.

address.description: Vault address in the chain's namespace: 0x-hex on EVM chains, base58 (case-sensitive) on Solana

tools.name: find_safest_vaults
tools.description: Find the highest risk-scored DeFi vaults, optionally filtered by asset, chain, or minimum TVL. Returns the top 10 audited vaults sorted by Philidor risk score (higher = lower assessed risk; scores are not a safety guarantee).

asset.description: Filter by asset symbol (e.g. USDC, WETH)

chain.description: Filter by chain name or slug (e.g. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Solana)

tools.name: get_protocol_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a DeFi protocol including TVL, vault count, versions, auditors, and security incidents.

protocolId.description: Protocol ID: aave, morpho, spark, compound, yearn, beefy, uniswap, nest, maple, kamino. Aave V4 is listed under aave (aave-v4 is accepted as an alias).

tools.name: get_curator_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a vault curator including their managed vaults, TVL, chain distribution, and performance.

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description: Get a high-level overview of the DeFi vault market: total TVL, vault count, risk distribution, and TVL by protocol.

tools.name: explain_risk_score
tools.description: Explain what a Philidor risk score means, including the tier (Prime/Core/Edge), how it is calculated, and what the thresholds are.

tools.name: list_vaults_with_incidents
tools.description: List all vaults that had a recent critical incident (last 365 days). Critical = severity Critical or incident_severity major. Results are sorted by TVL descending, then by time since event ascending (most recent first).

tools.name: check_policy
tools.description: State whether the positions you supply conform to the limits and constraints you supply. Calls POST /v1/graph/check and returns the API compliance attestation (attestation de conformité): compliance (compliant or non_compliant), violations, policy_hash, findings, and snapshotId. When issue is true and the API issues an attestation, the result also includes attestation_id, signerAddress, and the verification URL GET /v1/graph/attestation/{id}/verify. This states conformity with your policy. It does not recommend a vault. The same inputs produce the same result for every wallet. No Philidor policy is preselected. A missing or unknown API field is an error, never compliant. A caller without an eligible plan gets a structured refusal (required plan, x402 price, upgrade link), never an empty result. Philidor does not prepare transactions.

vaultKey.description: Vault key '{chainId}:{lowercase 0x address}', for example 1:0xabc... with 40 hex digits.

amountUsd.description: Position size in USD. Greater than 0.

positions.description: Positions to check. 1 to 100. This is not a wallet.

limits.description: Exposure caps as fractions in (0, 1]. Pass {} to set none. Omit a field to leave that dimension unconstrained. No Philidor cap is preselected.

constraints.description: Optional rules you set: minTier (Prime, Core, or Edge), allowlist and blacklist (max 1000 vault keys each; a key on both lists is not conforming because the blacklist wins), requireDepositStatus and requireWithdrawStatus (open only), maxFreshnessSeconds (integer 0 to 31622400). Omit the object to add none.

issue.description: When true, ask the API to issue a compliance attestation. Does not prepare a transaction.

agentId.description: Optional caller reference forwarded to the API. Not a wallet and not a key.

tools.name: list_baskets
tools.description: Returns the structured access refusal for the baskets family. Does not return constituents or weights.

tools.name: list_rwa
tools.description: Returns the structured access refusal for the rwa family. Does not return coverage.

tools.name: get_oracles
tools.description: Returns the structured access refusal for the oracles family. Does not return freshness.
